scripts.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && uv --directory backend sync --frozen && uv --directory fetcher sync --frozen && pnpm setup:browsers && pnpm setup:hooks
scripts.setup:browsers: pnpm --filter dashboard exec playwright install chromium
scripts.setup:hooks: uv --directory backend run pre-commit install --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type pre-push
scripts.dev:backend: uv --directory backend run python scripts/dev.py up-server
scripts.contracts:export: uv --directory backend run python scripts/export_ingress_contracts.py && uv --directory backend run python scripts/export_archive_contracts.py
scripts.contracts:check: uv --directory backend run python scripts/export_ingress_contracts.py --check && uv --directory backend run python scripts/export_archive_contracts.py --check
scripts.test: pnpm test:contracts && pnpm test:backend && pnpm test:fetcher && pnpm test:dashboard
scripts.test:backend: uv --directory backend run python scripts/dev.py test-db
scripts.format: pnpm format:dashboard && pnpm format:backend && pnpm format:fetcher
scripts.format:backend: uv --directory backend run ruff check --fix app tests scripts migrations && uv --directory backend run ruff format app tests scripts migrations
scripts.format:fetcher: uv --directory fetcher run ruff check --fix . && uv --directory fetcher run ruff format .
scripts.check: pnpm check:dashboard && pnpm check:backend && pnpm check:fetcher
scripts.check:dashboard: pnpm --filter dashboard format:check && pnpm --filter dashboard lint:check && pnpm --filter dashboard type:check
scripts.check:backend: uv --directory backend run ruff check app tests scripts migrations && uv --directory backend run ruff format --check app tests scripts migrations && uv --directory backend run mypy app
scripts.check:fetcher: uv --directory fetcher run ruff check . && uv --directory fetcher run ruff format --check . && uv --directory fetcher run mypy src
